title: Where2Act: From Pixels to Actions for Articulated 3D Objects
summary: A method that predicts per-point actionability, action proposals, and expected success for articulated 3D objects.

mechanisms.name: Per-point actionability and action proposals
mechanisms.description: Scores where an interaction primitive can succeed on an articulated object and proposes an action conditioned on the selected point.
mechanisms.limitations: Training on articulated-object simulation and primitive actions does not establish transfer to unstructured egocentric scenes or assistive navigation.
